name: Ryoujoku Disc NT-R
source:
Main character has married a month ago, and honeymoon relations are at bloom. One day a CD-R disc arrives, and on the video inside is his wife violated by the strangers...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-july-2006-bra-ban.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公一个月前刚刚结婚，夫妻正沉浸在新婚燕尔的甜蜜之中。一天，一张CD-R光盘突然寄到家中，里面的录像竟是妻子遭到陌生人凌辱的画面……
